editorial:
Imagine trying to make a great first impression on a date, but everything goes wrong because of a tiny human. That is exactly what happens to Eddie in this wild comedy. He gets invited over to his date's house, and he really wants to show her that he is a great guy with a soft side. The problem is her young son, who is basically a little agent of chaos. Eddie tries way too hard to be the fun guy and bond with the kid, but his paternal instincts are totally broken. It turns into a stressful yet hilarious mess as he tries to keep things under control while the house falls apart around him.

You will love how the tension builds up as the jokes land and the situation gets more awkward by the minute. The acting feels very real, making you feel the panic right along with Eddie. While the plot is simple, the pacing keeps you hooked until the very end. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the sharpest picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a perfect pick for a lazy Sunday when you just want to laugh at someone else's misfortune.
endingExplained: Everything reaches a breaking point when Eddie's attempt to entertain the boy leads to total disaster in the living room. After a series of funny accidents, the truth comes out about how bad he is with kids. Instead of the date ending in a breakup, the mom actually finds his desperation and failure kind of endearing. They end up laughing about the mess, and Eddie learns that being yourself is better than pretending to be a super dad.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves awkward situations and family comedies.
